svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: BNO08x: UART-SHTP
svg.desc: Schematic of the BNO08x uart-shtp: the chip with U2 MCU, C1 capacitor 100 nF, C2 capacitor 100 nF, C3 capacitor 100 nF, R3 resistor 10 kΩ, R4 resistor 4.7 kΩ, R5 resistor 4.7 kΩ, Y1 crystal 32.768 kHz; the MCU wires carry the port hooks IntAsserted(), TakeIntTimestamp(), SetBootn(), SetReset(), SetWake(), transport hooks.
svg.text: The BNO08x on an MCU's UART at 3 Mbit/s (PS1 high, PS0 low). The 32.768 kHz crystal is required: the internal clock is not accurate enough for a UART
mode. Above each MCU wire: the port hook that drives it. Datasheet: 1.2.3 UART-SHTP interface, p. 15.
* Not confirmed in the datasheet: R4 4.7 kΩ: the data sheet gives no value for the environmental bus; R5 4.7 kΩ: the data sheet gives no value for the environmental bus.
